title: Part Library rows can still be ticked and given a category with Set category
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create two parts for this test, part A and part B, both in category A.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
  • Make sure a second category, category B, exists.
  • Start on the Part Library page (Parts in the top bar, then Part Library in the left menu).
custom_steps:
1. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the Search box.
  2. Click the checkbox of the part A row.
  3. Click the checkbox of the part B row.
  4. Click the three-dot icon (⋮) at the left end of the table's header row.
  5. Click Set category.
  6. Pick category B.
  7. Confirm the new category in the Set category window.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Parts A and B are listed, both showing category A.

Step 2:

  • The part A row is ticked.

Step 3:

  • The part B row is ticked too.

Step 4:

  • The menu offers "Set category".

Step 5:

  • The Set category window opens.

Step 6:

  • Category B is picked.

Step 7:

  • The window closes and parts A and B now show category B in the Category column.
